title: Ziehl-Abegg - Wikipedia
content: **Ziehl-Abegg SE** (own notation ZIEHL-ABEGG SE, until 2013 *Ziehl-Abegg AG "Aktiengesellschaft (Deutschland)")*) is a German manufacturer of fans "Fan (machine)") for ventilation and air conditioning applications, as well as drive technology for elevators and motors with matching control technology. The company's headquarters are in Kuenzelsau, in Hohenlohekreis, Germany. In early 1910, the *Ziehl-Abegg Electricity Company* was founded in Berlin. Emil Ziehl and the Swiss engineer Eduard Abegg set up the company in Weißensee, a borough now part of the Pankow District. In 1960 began the production of an external rotor motor as a fan drive. In the late 1980s, Ziehl-Abegg became the first company in the world to introduce EC-Motors (see Brushless DC electric motor) and use them for Ventilation Technology. In 2013, Ziehl-Abegg was also the first company in the world to develop a Bio-Fan made entirely of a Bio-Polymer (in this case castor oil). Ziehl-Abegg USA Inc. is the North American subsidiary of the German high-tech company Ziehl-Abegg SE, headquartered in Künzelsau, Baden-Württemberg.

With Airstream Insights, Ziehl-Abegg is launching the world’s first fully AI-generated specialist podcast dedicated to ventilation technology. This is precisely where Ziehl-Abegg’s Airstream Insights steps in, providing fascinating insights into where ventilation technology comes into play and the pivotal role it plays in everyday life. With Airstream Insights, Ziehl-Abegg is breaking entirely new ground in the international B2B market: to date, there is no comparable English-language specialist podcast worldwide focused on ventilation technology, fans, and their applications that is exclusively AI-generated. “But our goal is to gain experience and inspire others to embrace AI.” CEO Ley adds, “That’s why this AI podcast aligns perfectly with our efforts to reward the best solutions for AI in communication through the AI Communication Award.”. title: Ziehl-Abegg: Even more power for the top class
content: ZIEHL-ABEGG is a leading international developer and manufacturer of products for ventilation systems, control engineering and drive technology. Fans made in Künzelsau serve the “Royal League” in ventilation systems, control engineering and drive technology as well as automotive applications. All signs point to further growth for the technological leader for fans – in order to achieve the set targets, ZIEHL-ABEGG has put its money on a new POWERFLOW e N2 line from Ersa for electronics manufacturing. Euro, 6% of turnover invested annually in R&D - employees: 3,800, of which 2,000 in Germany/Hohenlohe - products: fans, electric motors and control technology - Export share: 75%Production Manager Hermann Mütsch: the future of Ziehl-Abegg electronics production firmly in sight. The aim is always to offer technological solutions which are absolutely top-class – the in-wheel hub motor or electric drive for buses which has been under development by ZIEHL-ABEGG since 1998 is just one example of this.
